_about: Which artifact closes the demand each for-list pair makes. A reference naming a component is a claim that the
component owes that picture something; every name in a vault/SPECS-FOR.json for-list therefore has to resolve to
a gauntlet row that asserts, or to a test block that renders the component and holds the claim. `row:<id>` and
`test:<file>|<test title>` are checked by test/demand-coverage.test.mjs: a closedBy that does not exist, or names
a test whose title is not in that file, is a red. This file exists because closures that live only in prose
cannot be re-checked by the next agent, and the prose is where drift hides.
